description: Hand the desktop capsule's screen to the person watching, with a note saying exactly what you need (sign in, solve a CAPTCHA, approve a payment, check something). The console shows 'The AI needs you' with your note. Then waits until they press Done, hand back, and returns their note. Use this instead of typing passwords or secrets yourself.

note.description: What the person should do, in one or two plain sentences

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the hand back (default 300, max 900). 0 returns at once.

name: capsulate_handoff
title: Hand the screen to a person
